stem: Meena notices that the neem tree near her school in Rajasthan has small, narrow leaves and roots that grow very deep into the dry soil. What do these features show?

options.text: They are adaptations that help the neem tree survive in a dry region.
They are defects caused by poor soil in the school garden.
They show that the tree is dying because of lack of water.
They are changes that will disappear when the monsoon arrives.

teacher.key_rationale: Small narrow leaves reduce water loss and deep roots reach underground water; both give a survival advantage in a dry region, so they are adaptations. Other options deny the survival function or treat the features as temporary/defective.
